concepts.label: material discrepancy
source_quotes: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

concepts.label: applicant
source_quotes: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies
The applicant may not continue to use a previous name

concepts.label: passport specialist / adjudicator (you)
source_quotes: You must fully notate the name change documentation

evidence_quotes: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
relationships.explanation: Carves out an exception to the prohibition against continuing to use a previous name after a material name change when the documentation specifically permits it.

evidence_quotes: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;
relationships.explanation: Provides an alternative/exception to suspending the application when there is insufficient time prior to urgent or emergency travel.

raw.unit: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25): (1) Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders; or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.
